name: dsh-musage-card
description: Local fork of dsh-musage: multi-provider quota & balance glass card for the DSH sidebar footer (above the mobile-access button). 11 providers (MiniMax/DeepSeek/Kimi/Zhipu/OpenRouter/StepFun/SiliconFlow/Tavily/ZenMux/Xiaomi MiMo/Claude). Remaining-percentage countdown bars; tracks the selected model; credentials reused from DSH. Not published to any registry - installed via file: so the plugin market can never overwrite it.
